name: Concrete flatwork
summary: Driveways, patios and slabs priced from yards of ready-mix with waste, forms, mesh, finish and prep hours.

items.label: Pour and broom finish 4 in slab with wire mesh
items.source: STARTING_SLABS 20x40 + 3x20 ft at 4 in, broom 0.85 h/100 sq ft (index.html, FINISH_PRESETS); 4 in = 0.01235 cu yd/sq ft x (1 + wastePct 8%) x concretePerYd $175 = $2.333, plus mesh $0.35/sq ft (REINFORCEMENT_PRESETS, index.html default 'mesh'); quarter-yard ticket rounding not modeled; chute access adds no hours

items.label: Set and strip forms
items.source: perimeter 2x(20+40) + 2x(3+20) = 166 lf (calc.mjs slabPerimeter); formHours 6 spread over 166 lf; formPerLf $3.50 (index.html)

items.label: Prep, base, compaction and layout
items.source: prepHours 4 (index.html); the specialist has no base-material cost
